capabilities.title: Machine identity
capabilities.scope_note: Visible machine manufacturer/model/serial/UUID and virtualization; not full component manufacturing inventory.

capabilities.title: Processors
capabilities.scope_note: CPU model/logical CPU count/architecture; sockets, microcode and topology need deeper probes.

capabilities.title: Memory components
capabilities.scope_note: Total visible RAM only; DIMM identity, slots and ECC are not integrated.

capabilities.title: Controllers and attached devices
capabilities.scope_note: PCIe/USB/controllers/enclosures and connection topology are not integrated.

capabilities.title: Firmware and boot platform
capabilities.scope_note: BIOS/UEFI/BMC/device firmware and Secure Boot are not integrated.

capabilities.title: Environmental sensors
capabilities.scope_note: Available Linux thermal-zone and hwmon values only; explicit opt-in and source scope apply.

capabilities.title: Hardware health events
capabilities.scope_note: ECC, power, throttling and hardware error events are not integrated.

capabilities.title: Block devices
capabilities.scope_note: Observed block-device columns only; complete serial/controller/path inventory is not implied.

capabilities.title: Filesystems and mounts
capabilities.scope_note: Observed filesystem sources and mounts, not configured mount policy or full filesystem attributes.

capabilities.title: Storage layers and remote sources
capabilities.scope_note: OS/controller/MD/virtual-drive evidence is integrated; no full LVM/ZFS/LUKS/SAN or physical-to-OS mapping.

capabilities.title: Capacity and allocation
capabilities.scope_note: Filesystem space/inodes and swap; no quota/thin-pool/snapshot accounting or growth prediction.

capabilities.title: Storage I/O
capabilities.scope_note: Linux cumulative disk counters only; no automatic rates, saturation diagnosis or latency baseline.

capabilities.title: Media and array health
capabilities.scope_note: Specialized disk/RAID retained health/policy is integrated; not generic SMART or all-controller coverage.

capabilities.title: Operating system and kernel
capabilities.scope_note: Visible platform/kernel/distribution identity and timezone abbreviation, not full kernel/configuration inventory.

capabilities.title: Installed packages and tools
capabilities.scope_note: Platform package/receipt/VIB snapshot; not universal application coverage or a full SBOM.

capabilities.title: Language environments and modules
capabilities.scope_note: Per-runtime/per-user/isolated environments and module discovery are not integrated.

capabilities.title: Libraries in use
capabilities.scope_note: Installed versus actively loaded libraries and dependency relationships are not integrated.

capabilities.title: Interfaces and addresses
capabilities.scope_note: Observed interfaces/MAC/MTU/state/IPv4/IPv6; not full physical or namespace topology.

capabilities.title: Name resolution
capabilities.scope_note: Resolver-file nameservers only, not all effective DNS/search/hosts policy.

capabilities.title: Routing
capabilities.scope_note: Platform route rows only; complete policy routing is not guaranteed.

capabilities.title: Listening endpoints
capabilities.scope_note: Platform-visible TCP/UDP endpoints; no external reachability claim.

capabilities.title: Firewall and packet policy
capabilities.scope_note: nft JSON, iptables/ip6tables saves and firewalld/UFW native views; runtime and configured frontend scope distinguished, no cross-backend reconciliation or external reachability proof.

capabilities.title: Connection activity
capabilities.scope_note: Inbound/outbound connections, lifecycles and destinations are not integrated.

capabilities.title: Interface traffic and errors
capabilities.scope_note: Cumulative traffic/error/discard counters; no automatic rates or event history.

capabilities.title: Service inventory and state
capabilities.scope_note: Platform-visible service rows only; application health and dependency discovery are not implied.

capabilities.title: Time synchronization
capabilities.scope_note: timedatectl, chrony tracking/sources, ntpq state/peers and selected configured time sources; optional tools, permissions, unsupported outputs and clock uncertainty explicit.

capabilities.title: Applications and database instances
capabilities.scope_note: Configured MySQL replica identity/channels/health are integrated; automatic application/database discovery remains missing.

capabilities.title: Scheduled work
capabilities.scope_note: Cron/timer inventories and execution histories are not integrated.

capabilities.title: Process identity and behavior
capabilities.scope_note: Visible Linux procfs process identity/resource snapshot is integrated; no complete lifecycle, argv/environment, I/O-rate or network attribution.

capabilities.title: System resource pressure
capabilities.scope_note: CPU/load/available RAM/Linux PSI and uptime; not complete resource accounting or workload attribution.

capabilities.title: Users and groups
capabilities.scope_note: Local Linux passwd/group files are integrated; NSS/directory identities, effective login and sudo policy remain missing.

capabilities.title: Authentication and login policy
capabilities.scope_note: OpenSSH -T selected settings; explicit complete Match context optional. No OS/PAM/key inventory, login proof, running-daemon command-line override discovery or complete access policy.

capabilities.title: Privilege boundaries
capabilities.scope_note: Noninteractive current-actor sudo -ll projection; Defaults and command arguments omitted, unsupported details explicit. No su/PAM/other-actor or complete sudoers analysis.

capabilities.title: Authentication and privilege events
capabilities.scope_note: Login success/failure, sessions and privilege-use events are not integrated.

capabilities.title: Logging and audit pipelines
capabilities.scope_note: Selected journald/rsyslog/nginx/MySQL/logrotate directives and journal disk-usage metadata; no log contents, effective inheritance/merge, auditd/syslog-ng or general log-pipeline health proof.

capabilities.title: Monitoring agents
capabilities.scope_note: SNMP/other agent capabilities and event destinations are not integrated; secrets are not ordinary profile data.

capabilities.title: Configuration drift
capabilities.scope_note: Cross-domain expected configuration and change analysis are not integrated.

capabilities.title: Performance baselines
capabilities.scope_note: Sampling history is available separately; seasonal baselines and anomaly models are not integrated.

capabilities.title: Behavior and correlation
capabilities.scope_note: Cross-source process/connection/login baselines and correlation are not integrated.
